title: Healthcare Data Analytics and Population Health Reporting
raw_description: Fraser Health Authority requires a vendor to build population health analytics dashboards integrating data from multiple clinical systems (Epic EHR, lab systems, pharmacy data). Deliverables include: Tableau or Power BI dashboards for 6 clinical programs, data integration layer connecting Epic HL7 FHIR APIs to a central analytics store, automated metric calculation for 30+ population health KPIs, and self-service reporting for clinical managers. FOIPPA and PHIPA compliance is mandatory. The vendor must demonstrate prior work with health authority data and clinical analytics.

ground_truth.rationale: Good match on BI tools and data integration. Healthcare context adds compliance risk but Fraser Health is a major BC client. $480K is a solid engagement. HL7 FHIR integration is specialized.
